name: Pierre-Auguste Renoir

summary.text: Pierre-Auguste Renoir was a leading French Impressionist artist. In his depiction of feminine beauty, Renoir has been described as "the final representative of a tradition which runs directly from Rubens to Watteau."
summary.title: Pierre-Auguste Renoir
